proof.text: Let D be the integral tensor of M and N. The reductionTensor field gives an isomorphism e from C.reduction(D) to the system tensor of their reductions. Normalized reconstruction and C.reduction_normalized make the actual counit at C.reduction(D) invertible. The naturality square of the counit at e.hom identifies the composite of the mapped isomorphism with the desired counit with the counit at C.reduction(D) followed by e.hom. The latter is invertible. Cancel the mapped isomorphism to obtain the desired result. This also handles zero inputs and empty schemes, using only isomorphism naturality.

title: Counit on a tensor of reduced coefficient systems
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W with l invertible in each residue field, a coefficient derived system calculus C [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus] over W and arbitrary unbounded derived completed-coefficient objects M,N. The actual counit of C at C.systemClosed.tensor(C.reduction(M),C.reduction(N)) is invertible. No boundedness or constructibility assumption is used.
